g.text: mean attention mass to spatial key

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: VDA16 4×4 · affine_ew · cue-proportion sweep on no-change trials

Rows are displayed cue proportions; columns are logical timesteps. Every cell averages 96 matched no-change trials and all query patches. Red outline = the single fixed cue location S1 (top-left). Affine maps retain the single spatial-key array.
